fix_subject: duckdb-ubs: keep coalesce a catalog lookup on the plain path, reject modifiers on the chain

labels.summary: The parser rewrite helper treated coalesce as a syntax-node rewrite for every call form, so quoted or schema-qualified calls ignored user macros named coalesce, and chained coalesce calls silently dropped DISTINCT and ORDER BY; the fix restricts the rewrite to the method chain, rejects those modifiers there, and restores catalog lookup for other forms. The defects were introduced by the same PR rather than present in the base, so the bug label is less certain.

not_strict_because: no failing fix-added case (fix-modified file only)
